_comment: Canonical, machine-checkable repository hardening policy for Ampersand/CrossInput.
scripts/check-workflow-policy.py enforces this statically in CI and, with --live,
compares it against the actual GitHub ruleset / security configuration.
Changing anything here is a deliberate control change and must be reviewed as such.

required_status_checks.promotion_evidence: PR #159 exact HEAD adc9ceaf8e386fe5e267bfe88c75337175ec3703 produced successful Dependency Review run 35501846617. PR #186 promoted the checked-in gate; authoritative 2026-09-22 readback confirmed live ruleset 21739720 requires Dependency Review with GitHub Actions integration id 15368 and no bypass actors.

exceptions.evidence: github/codeql-action v4.38.1 managed CodeQL CLI 2.27.0 rejects the maintained Kotlin 2.4.20 compiler path as too recent
exceptions.forbidden_workaround: Do not use an external/nightly tools override or downgrade Kotlin solely to obtain a green advisory scanner
exceptions.reassessment_trigger: Issue #157: restore only when the stable action-managed bundle accepts Kotlin 2.4.20 and exact-head extraction/analyze/upload succeeds

manual_live_readbacks.codeql: CodeQL default-setup administration state requires repository administration read authority; custom CodeQL workflow remains the checked-in authority.
manual_live_readbacks.actions/permissions: Repository Actions execution policy is an administration surface; scheduled low-privilege audit records it as manual-unverified when unreadable.
manual_live_readbacks.actions/permissions/workflow: Default GITHUB_TOKEN workflow permissions are an administration surface; scheduled low-privilege audit records them as manual-unverified when unreadable.
